meta.name: Bismuth Lantern
meta.description: A heavy, angular lantern radiating a dampening field. When placed on a tile deep underground or on high-tier rock, it absorbs the shockwaves of nearby explosions, ensuring the tile takes no secondary damage. Must be purchased from the Rivet Smith.
meta.author: jules:session

modifiers.if: tile.covered_by_self and ctx.is_secondary_damage == 1 and (tile.depth >= 500.0 or tile.tier >= 1.0)
